class.name: GameInputReading
class.brief_description: Snapshot of one device's input, with the previous state for press and release edges.
class.description: [GameInputReading] is an immutable snapshot of a single device's input, captured by [method GameInput.poll] (or on demand by [method GameInput.get_current_reading]) or delivered by [signal GameInput.reading_received]. It covers every input kind the device supports — gamepad, keyboard, mouse, motion sensors, arcade stick, flight stick, racing wheel and the raw controller axes, buttons and switches — except raw device reports, and [method get_input_kinds] tells which ones it contains. Methods for a kind the reading does not contain return [code]false[/code], [code]0[/code] or an empty value. Each reading also holds the state it replaced, so the [code]was_*_pressed[/code] and [code]was_*_released[/code] methods report edges. For polled readings the previous state is the previous poll; for [signal GameInput.reading_received] it is the previous reading of that device. When there is no previous state yet ([method has_previous] returns [code]false[/code]), for example on the first reading after a device connects, press methods report [code]true[/code] for inputs that are already down and release methods report [code]false[/code]. Button methods take bit masks. A mask with several bits is a chord: [method is_button_down] returns [code]true[/code] only when every bit is held, and the edge methods report the moment the whole chord becomes held or stops being held. Masks with bits that do not exist for that kind always return [code]false[/code]. [enum GameInputDevice.Source] values give one vocabulary for gamepad, arcade stick, flight stick and racing wheel inputs: [method is_source_down], [method was_source_pressed], [method was_source_released] and [method get_source_value] accept any of them, which is what [GameInputMapper] uses.

method.name: is_button_down
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if every bit of [param button], a [enum GameInputDevice.Button] flag or several flags OR-ed together, is held on the gamepad. Returns [code]false[/code] for [constant GameInputDevice.BUTTON_NONE], for masks with bits outside [enum GameInputDevice.Button], and when the reading has no gamepad state. Use this for "while held" checks; use [method was_button_pressed] for one-shot triggers.

method.name: was_button_pressed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] only on the press edge of [param button]: the button (or, for a mask, the whole chord) is held now and was not held in the previous state. Returns [code]false[/code] for unknown button values. Without a previous state (see [method has_previous]), this falls back to "currently down".

method.name: was_button_released
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] only on the release edge of [param button]: the button (or, for a mask, the whole chord) was held in the previous state and is not held now. Returns [code]false[/code] when there is no previous state to compare against, or when [param button] is unknown.

method.name: get_axis
method.description: Returns the value of [param axis], a [enum GameInputDevice.Axis] index. Thumbstick axes are in [code][-1.0, 1.0][/code] and triggers in [code][0.0, 1.0][/code]; the thumbstick Y axes are sign-flipped from the native [code]GameInputGamepadState[/code] to match Godot's convention (down is positive). Racing wheel and flight stick axes are returned as GameInput reports them (see the [enum GameInputDevice.Axis] constants for their ranges). Returns [code]0.0[/code] for unknown axis ids.

method.name: get_buttons_mask
method.description: Returns the raw current gamepad buttons bitfield. The bit layout matches the native [code]GameInputGamepadButtons[/code] flags, which is also what the [enum GameInputDevice.Button] constants encode. Useful for batch comparisons or serialization.

method.name: get_timestamp
method.description: Returns when this reading was taken, in microseconds on the GameInput clock; compare it with [method GameInput.get_current_timestamp]. For a reading that combines several input kinds this is the newest of their timestamps; [method get_kind_timestamp] returns one kind's timestamp. Returns [code]0[/code] for a reading without data.

method.name: get_device_id
method.description: Returns the id of the device this reading came from, the same value as [method GameInputDevice.get_device_id].

method.name: get_kind_timestamp
method.description: Returns the GameInput timestamp, in microseconds, of the part of this reading that holds [param kind], a [enum GameInput.DeviceKind] flag. For a mask, the newest timestamp among those kinds is returned. Returns [code]0[/code] when the reading has none of those kinds.

method.name: get_input_kinds
method.description: Returns the [enum GameInput.DeviceKind] flags of the input this reading contains. The raw controller axes, buttons and switches all report [constant GameInput.DEVICE_CONTROLLER].

method.name: has_previous
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the reading holds a previous state for at least one of its kinds, so release edges can be reported. It is [code]false[/code] for the first reading after a device connects and for readings fetched on demand before the first poll.

method.name: has_gap_before
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when readings of this device were lost just before this one, because the reading ring overflowed or reading callbacks were re-registered. Edges computed against the previous state may then span the missing readings. When more than 16 devices lose readings between two polls, the next reading of every device reports a gap. Always [code]false[/code] for polled readings. See [method GameInput.get_dropped_reading_count].

method.name: is_truncated
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the device reported more input than a reading can hold, so some of it was dropped: more than 32 simultaneous keys, or more than 32 axes, 128 buttons or 8 switches on the raw controller.

method.name: is_source_down
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param source], a [enum GameInputDevice.Source] value, is active: a button source is held, or an axis source has an absolute value of [code]0.5[/code] or more. Returns [code]false[/code] for unknown sources and for sources of an input kind the reading does not contain.

method.name: was_source_pressed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] on the edge where [param source] becomes active (see [method is_source_down]). Without a previous state for its kind, this falls back to "currently active".

method.name: was_source_released
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] on the edge where [param source] stops being active (see [method is_source_down]). Returns [code]false[/code] when there is no previous state for its kind.

method.name: get_source_value
method.description: Returns the value of [param source], a [enum GameInputDevice.Source] value: the axis value for axis sources (as [method get_axis] returns it), or [code]1.0[/code] when a button source is held and [code]0.0[/code] when it is not. Returns [code]0.0[/code] for unknown sources and for sources of an input kind the reading does not contain.

method.name: get_key_count
method.description: Returns the number of keys held on the keyboard, up to 32. Returns [code]0[/code] when the reading has no keyboard state.

method.name: get_pressed_physical_keys
method.description: Returns the physical [enum @GlobalScope.Key] values of the keys held on the keyboard, without duplicates. Keys are identified by their position, like [member InputEventKey.physical_keycode], so [constant @GlobalScope.KEY_W] is the key in the W position on any layout. Scan codes without a Godot key are left out.

method.name: is_physical_key_down
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the key in the position of [param physical_key], a physical [enum @GlobalScope.Key] value such as [constant @GlobalScope.KEY_W], is held.

method.name: was_physical_key_pressed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] on the edge where the key in the position of [param physical_key] becomes held. Without a previous keyboard state, this falls back to "currently held".

method.name: was_physical_key_released
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] on the edge where the key in the position of [param physical_key] stops being held. Returns [code]false[/code] when there is no previous keyboard state.

method.name: get_key_states
method.description: Returns one [Dictionary] per held key, up to 32, in the order GameInput reports them. Keys: [code]scan_code[/code] (extended keys use the [code]0xE0xx[/code] form), [code]virtual_key[/code] (Windows virtual-key code), [code]code_point[/code] (the Unicode character the key produces with the current layout, or [code]0[/code]), [code]is_dead_key[/code] ([bool]), [code]physical_keycode[/code] (see [method GameInputDevice.scan_code_to_physical_key]), [code]keycode[/code] (see [method GameInputDevice.virtual_key_to_keycode]) and [code]location[/code] ([enum @GlobalScope.KeyLocation], left or right for modifier keys). Returns an empty [Array] when the reading has no keyboard state.

method.name: get_mouse_buttons
method.description: Returns the [enum GameInputDevice.MouseButton] flags held on the mouse.

method.name: is_mouse_button_down
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if every bit of [param button], a [enum GameInputDevice.MouseButton] flag or several OR-ed together, is held.

method.name: was_mouse_button_pressed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] on the edge where [param button] (or, for a mask, the whole chord) becomes held. Without a previous mouse state, this falls back to "currently held".

method.name: was_mouse_button_released
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] on the edge where [param button] (or, for a mask, the whole chord) stops being held. Returns [code]false[/code] when there is no previous mouse state.

method.name: get_mouse_delta
method.description: Returns how far the mouse moved since the previous state, computed from the cumulative position GameInput reports. The values are mouse motion, not screen pixels. Returns [code]Vector2(0, 0)[/code] without a previous mouse state.

method.name: get_mouse_wheel_delta
method.description: Returns how far the horizontal ([code]x[/code]) and vertical ([code]y[/code]) scroll wheels moved since the previous state, computed from the cumulative wheel values GameInput reports. Returns [code]Vector2(0, 0)[/code] without a previous mouse state.

method.name: has_mouse_absolute_position
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the device reports an absolute position ([code]GameInputMouseAbsolutePosition[/code]). Regular mice only report relative motion.

method.name: get_mouse_absolute_position
method.description: Returns the absolute position reported by the device, in its own units. Returns [code]Vector2(0, 0)[/code] when [method has_mouse_absolute_position] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: get_mouse_state
method.description: Returns the raw mouse state as a [Dictionary]: [code]buttons[/code] ([enum GameInputDevice.MouseButton] flags), [code]positions[/code] (the GameInput position flags), [code]x[/code] and [code]y[/code] (accumulated relative motion), [code]absolute_x[/code] and [code]absolute_y[/code], and [code]wheel_x[/code] and [code]wheel_y[/code] (accumulated wheel motion). The accumulated values are 64-bit integers that wrap; use [method get_mouse_delta] and [method get_mouse_wheel_delta] for per-reading motion. Returns an empty [Dictionary] when the reading has no mouse state.

method.name: get_sensor_kinds
method.description: Returns the [enum GameInputDevice.SensorKind] flags of the sensors the device has, when the reading contains sensor data; [code]0[/code] otherwise. Only the getters for these sensors return meaningful values.

method.name: get_accelerometer
method.description: Returns the acceleration measured by the device, in metres per second squared. GameInput reports it in g, which is multiplied by [code]9.80665[/code]. Returns [code]Vector3(0, 0, 0)[/code] when the reading has no sensor data.

method.name: get_gyroscope
method.description: Returns the angular velocity measured by the device's gyrometer, in radians per second around each axis. Returns [code]Vector3(0, 0, 0)[/code] when the reading has no sensor data.

method.name: get_heading_degrees
method.description: Returns the compass heading in degrees. Check [method get_heading_accuracy] before trusting it. Returns [code]0.0[/code] when the reading has no sensor data.

method.name: get_heading_accuracy
method.description: Returns the accuracy of [method get_heading_degrees] as a [enum GameInputDevice.SensorAccuracy] value.

method.name: get_orientation
method.description: Returns the device orientation reported by GameInput as a [Quaternion]. Returns the identity [Quaternion] when the reading has no sensor data.

method.name: get_arcade_stick_buttons
method.description: Returns the [enum GameInputDevice.ArcadeStickButton] flags held on the arcade stick, including the stick directions. Returns [code]0[/code] when the reading has no arcade stick state.

method.name: get_flight_stick_buttons
method.description: Returns the [enum GameInputDevice.FlightStickButton] flags held on the flight stick, including the hat switch directions. Returns [code]0[/code] when the reading has no flight stick state.

method.name: get_flight_stick_hat
method.description: Returns the flight stick's hat switch position as a [enum GameInputDevice.SwitchPosition] value; [constant GameInputDevice.SWITCH_CENTER] when it is not pressed or the reading has no flight stick state.

method.name: get_flight_stick_hat_vector
method.description: Returns the flight stick's hat switch position as a direction [Vector2], using [method GameInputDevice.switch_position_to_vector].

method.name: get_racing_wheel_buttons
method.description: Returns the [enum GameInputDevice.RacingWheelButton] flags held on the racing wheel. Returns [code]0[/code] when the reading has no racing wheel state.

method.name: get_racing_wheel_gear
method.description: Returns the gear selected with the racing wheel's pattern shifter, as GameInput reports it. See [code]min_pattern_shifter_gear[/code] and [code]max_pattern_shifter_gear[/code] in [method GameInputDevice.get_device_info]. Returns [code]0[/code] when the reading has no racing wheel state.

method.name: get_controller_axes
method.description: Returns every raw controller axis, up to 32, normalized by GameInput to [code][0.0, 1.0][/code]. The order and meaning of the axes are device-specific. Returns an empty array when the reading has no raw controller axes.

method.name: get_controller_buttons
method.description: Returns the state of every raw controller button, up to 128, as an [Array] of [bool]. Returns an empty [Array] when the reading has no raw controller buttons.

method.name: get_controller_switches
method.description: Returns every raw controller switch, up to 8, as [enum GameInputDevice.SwitchPosition] values. Returns an empty array when the reading has no raw controller switches.

method.name: get_controller_axis
method.description: Returns raw controller axis [param index]. Returns [code]0.0[/code] for an index out of range or when the reading has no raw controller axes.

method.name: is_controller_button_down
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if raw controller button [param index] is held. Returns [code]false[/code] for an index out of range or when the reading has no raw controller buttons.

method.name: was_controller_button_pressed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] on the edge where raw controller button [param index] becomes held. Without a previous state for the raw buttons, this falls back to "currently held".

method.name: was_controller_button_released
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] on the edge where raw controller button [param index] stops being held. Returns [code]false[/code] when there is no previous state for the raw buttons.

method.name: get_controller_switch
method.description: Returns raw controller switch [param index] as a [enum GameInputDevice.SwitchPosition] value. Returns [constant GameInputDevice.SWITCH_CENTER] for an index out of range or when the reading has no raw controller switches.
